newsitem.title: USA: Perry says mergers improved defense industry.
newsitem.headline: Perry says mergers improved defense industry.

text.p: Defense Secretary William Perry said Thursday that post-Cold War mergers have made the U.S. defense industry more effective, not less.
"I would say that in the last four years the effectiveness of the defense industry, the diversity the responsiveness to our needs has increased, not decreased," Perry told reporters.
He said that was partly because defense contractors themselves have managed the consolidation effectively.
Perry said he could not say what position the Defense Department might take on Boeing Co's proposed merger with McDonnell Douglas Corp because its study has just begun.

But he said the possible Pentagon positions are that the merger will not create a monopoly, that it will, or that it would create a monopoly only of certain weapons. In the third case, the Pentagon would not oppose it if one company or the other divested its work on those weapons.
